messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#12345 — high 5xx rate on embeddings-api in eu-west1. 5m avg 5xx% = 28% (threshold 5%). Link: https://pd.example/incident/12345
pagerduty: Incident created and routed to SRE rotation. Auto-escalation in 3m if unacked.
tilly: Acked. I'm on it. :wave:
mike: Oncall-tilly — any quick context? Recent deploys/rollouts?
tilly: No deploys from our team in last 2 hours. I see a bump in requests to /v1/embeddings/generate. Possibly upstream client spike. Customer error rate reports from CS showing degraded embeddings.
jordan: I'm pulling logs and recent envoy metrics now. Preliminary: 502s originating from model worker pool (kvcache errors). Starting tail:
```
2026-03-18T02:40:12Z ERROR kvcache: kvproxy call timeout to eu-west1-02: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-18T02:40:13Z WARN  inference: model-worker 172.31.5.22 OOM kill
```
anya: Noted OOMs on model-worker pool — could be memory leak with new quantization plugin rolled out yesterday to dedicated hosts.
mike: Can we drain and restart affected workers in eu-west1-02? Tilly, can you trigger rolling restart for pool inference-eu-quant? 
tilly: Starting rolling restart for inference-eu-quant. Using runbook step 2 -> `scripts/rotate-workers --pool inference-eu-quant --max-surge 1` . ETA ~6m. :hourglass:
jordan: Meanwhile routing to fallback variant (quant -> fp16) for critical customer routes: enabling fallback for route embeddings-prod/global via router flags.
incident-bot: Routing change applied: embeddings-prod/global -> fallback-model:fp16 (soft) — 12m ago, 20% traffic diverted.
mike: Keep an eye on 5xx%. If it drops under 5% we can mark partial mitigation. Also reach out to CS for impacted customers list and prepare status note.
tilly: Restart completed on 6/8 workers so far, OOMs decreased on restarted nodes.
jordan: 5xx% now 9% (was 28%). CPU on model nodes spiked during restart but stable.
anya: I'll open a postmortem ticket and tag quant-plugin team. Potential root cause: plugin regression causing memory growth during certain prompt shapes.
mike: Thanks. Tilly / Jordan — keep monitoring and update PD incident when we reach stable. I'll notify product & CS. :thumbsup:
tilly: Update: last worker restarted, 5xx% down to 2.6% and SLOs restored. Closing PD auto-escalation. I'll leave a short note in incident ticket.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident resolved (PD#12345).
